source_anchor: CLRS §31.1 elementary number-theory operations (digit extraction via mod and floor-divide); standard recreational math textbook
prompt_text: Sum the decimal digits of 12345 and print the total. Expected output: "15".

exec_cell.code: let n=12345; let s=0; while(n>0){s+=n%10; n=Math.floor(n/10);} console.log(s);

candidate_responses.text: CORRECT: string conversion + reduce — different idiom, same sum.
WRONG: loop guard n>=10 (instead of n>0) exits with one digit remaining — drops the leading "1" of 12345.
candidate_responses.code: let n=12345; let s=0; while(n>=10){s+=n%10; n=Math.floor(n/10);} console.log(s);

candidate_responses.text: CARGO-CULT: digits / String / split vocabulary, but returns the COUNT of digits (length) instead of summing them.
candidate_responses.code: const num=12345; const digits=String(num).split(""); const total=digits.length; console.log(total);
